source_policy: Read in place. No captured files or data copied into the repository.

interfaces.file_memory: One fact per file; MEMORY.md is the index and excluded from the count. Look up relative filename and search full file text.
interfaces.ava_memory: memory_store.get_store(); get_all(limit) with growing limit until exhausted; get(memory_id) returns memory; search(query, limit) returns id and memory. DATA_DIR beside config.py contains chromadb and history.db. USER_ID ava.
interfaces.knowledge_graph: db.list_entities() enumerates; get_entity(entity_id=...) retrieves; search_entities(query) searches name or description. Entities are the sampled memory unit specified by AC4. knowledge_graph.db beside db.py includes entities, relationships, facts and embeddings; the entire database is backed up.
interfaces.memory_kb: kb.config.COLLECTIONS has seven named collections. kb.store._get_collection(name).count() and get(limit, offset, include) enumerate untruncated documents; get(ids=[document id]) looks up. kb.store._decrypt_results supplies readable restricted text or the adapter refuses. kb.search.search(query, collections=[name], n_results) searches. Fixed data/chromadb. Enumerate _get_client().list_collections(), bind _get_collection to get_collection with the captured embedding function in this subprocess, and never create an absent collection.
interfaces.claude_mem: Installed plugin 10.6.2 (package.json version; other versions are refused until audited). Counts and the random sample come from a consistent private copy of the named claude-mem.db (observations, session_summaries, user_prompts). Each sampled memory is fetched by id through claude-mem's own routes (search server get_observations; worker /api/session/:id and /api/prompt/:id) and searched for through the search server's search tool (type, project, format json, dateStart 1970-01-01, the first 2000 characters of the longest text claude-mem indexes: observation narrative, text and each fact; summary request, investigated, learned, completed, next_steps and notes; prompt_text). Memories for which claude-mem indexes no text are fetched by id only. The search server runs from the manifest's command against a dedicated worker (bun scripts/worker-service.cjs --daemon) whose HOME, CLAUDE_MEM_DATA_DIR and Chroma are a private copy, on its own port, with ps listing nothing, no pending work and no Claude executable; every process carrying that HOME is stopped afterwards.

limits: Synthetic Chroma backend represents the document/metadata subset; no embedding model download or live semantic quality claim.
Direct captured Python wrappers run over injected synthetic backend APIs. The captured MCP script runs against a loopback worker API stand-in.
The graph sample unit is entity, as named by the specification, not each relationship or fact. All SQLite tables are copied.

The claude-mem check depends on claude-mem's semantic search over its Chroma copy: a memory missing from Chroma is searched again after the dedicated worker's own backfill. chroma-mcp resolves through uvx with the owner's uv cache and settings; UV_ variables pass through.
